Post natively in the Instagram app.

posts.alt: Expansive San Diego backyard set for an end-of-summer gathering with a long pergola dining table, string lights, an outdoor kitchen and a linear fire feature at golden hour
posts.hook: Happy Labor Day. This is what the backyard was built for.
posts.caption:
Happy Labor Day.

This is the weekend a well-designed backyard earns its keep — the long table under the pergola, the grill going, the fire lit as the light drops. One space that holds everyone you'd want around it, comfortably, for hours.

The selections:
• cedar pergola with string lights
• built-in outdoor kitchen & bar
• linear stone fire feature
• Belgard paver patio
• SYNLawn turf & olive trees

posts.alt: La Jolla modern backyard outdoor kitchen and bar with a Lynx grill, porcelain counters and a StruXure pergola with an ocean view
posts.hook: The bar is where the night actually happens.
posts.caption:
Add a bar to the kitchen and the whole dynamic changes — people stop passing through and start staying put.

Seating on the guest side, the cooking suite on the other, porcelain counters that wipe clean, and an ocean view behind it all.

The selections:
• Lynx built-in grill
• Danver stainless cabinetry
• porcelain counters
• StruXure louvered pergola
• ocean-view siting

Want a bar built into your yard? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Symmetrical paver driveway with formal landscaping in front of a Mediterranean San Diego home
posts.hook: Symmetry reads as expensive. Even from the street.
posts.caption:
There's a reason grand houses lean on symmetry — the eye reads it as order, and order reads as expensive.

Matched pavers running to a centered entry, mirrored planting on each side, a crisp border to hold the whole composition. It works before anyone's out of the car.

The selections:
• Belgard pavers, symmetrical field
• soldier-course border
• matched olive trees
• boxwood & agave
• path lighting

Want an entrance with this kind of order? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Solana Beach coastal backyard at twilight with a linear fire feature beside a glowing pool, a travertine deck and palms
posts.hook: Fire and water, ten feet apart, both yours.
posts.caption:
Fire and water side by side is the oldest trick in luxury design — and it still stops people cold at twilight.

A linear flame reflected in a still pool, travertine glowing under low light, the sky going deep blue behind the palms. This is the yard at its best hour.

The selections:
• linear fire feature
• rectangular pool
• travertine deck
• FX Luminaire lighting
• coastal palms

Want fire and water in your yard? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.style: Trust & Difference · By Design, Not by Dispatch
posts.alt: Elegant Rancho Santa Fe estate backyard with a stone fireplace lounge, olive trees and a travertine patio at golden hour
posts.hook: We only build a handful of yards a year. Yours would be one of them.
posts.caption:
We don't chase volume. We take a small number of projects a year, plan them for months, and build each with a single dedicated crew from first paver to last.

That's the whole idea behind by design, not by dispatch — scarcity and intention are the product. A yard like this isn't rushed into existence. It's composed.

The selections:
• natural-stone fireplace
• travertine patio
• deep linen seating
• mature olive trees
• FX Luminaire lighting

Want to be one of this year's builds? DM “DESIGN”.
